documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results
Board Meeting Outcome for Approval Of Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported a strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, delivering 27% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 347 crores, EBITDA growth of 55% to INR 90 crores, and PAT growth of 64% to INR 57 crores. Growth was driven by robust demand in the construction equipment segment and market share gains, while large agricultural equipment markets remained subdued. Management expects FY27 revenue growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 growth, supported by a healthy trailing 12-month order book of over INR 225 crores. Strategic milestones include the rollout of customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse in Q3 FY27 and progress on evaluating M&A opportunities. Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 27% year-on-year, EBITDA growth of 55% year-on-year, and PAT growth of 64% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 top line growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q2 FY27 performance to be in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: So Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: Uniparts remains confident of delivering over 20% EBITDA margin across the industry cycle.
guidance.quote: We, actually are confident that 20% plus is what we will deliver.

guidance.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3 of FY27.
guidance.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

guidance.claim: Revenue from Mexico warehouse operations in FY27 is expected to be in the mid-single-digit million-dollar level.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: Uniparts India stated that its Q1 FY27 performance aligned with quarter-on-quarter guidance and exceeded annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects revenue growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26, driven by an improving industry cycle and business wins.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 performance to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26, with H2 FY27 expected to be stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment momentum started in H2 CY2025 has continued into Q1 FY27, driven by infrastructure investments in the U.S. and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: On the construction equipment, the momentum that started in the second half of calendar year 2025 has continued into Q1 of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment market conditions remain subdued, with CY2026 expected to mark the cyclical bottom ahead of a CY2027 recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the large agricultural equipment, conditions remain subdued as has been widely acknowledged across the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment demand in India continues to perform well due to government subsidy programs and adoption across mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment in Western markets is beginning to see volume recovery after three consecutive years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: After 3 consecutive years of volume decline, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket revenue contributed approximately 12% of total Q1 FY27 revenues and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and government-led spending in Europe are sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Unit volumes in small agriculture in Western markets are showing signs of recovery after three consecutive years of decline.
demand_outlook.quote: That said, the bottom appears to be behind us; after three consecutive years of volume declines, we are beginning to see some recovery in unit volumes, and the direction of growth is encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate that CY2026 marks the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners in the aftermarket segment to moderate purchasing.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: Construction equipment demand in North America is expected to gradually strengthen through FY27, with the second half outperforming the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is expected to achieve around 5% growth in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: North American industry volumes for large tractors continue to decline in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts incurred capital expenditure of INR 12 crores during Q1 FY27 for capacity enhancement, productivity improvements, and customer initiatives.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule without customer supply disruption.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts will consider local manufacturing in Mexico during Phase 2 of its expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: In Phase 2, we will also be considering manufacturing in Mexico.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse operations are expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts plans to keep capex consistent at 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for Q4 FY26 was INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of materials in Q1 FY27 stood at 33.3%, primarily reflecting a shift in product mix.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 reached INR 90 crores, up 55% year-on-year and 10% quarter-on-quarter due to operating leverage and cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Warehouse-led sales generate the highest margin profile among all delivery channels for Uniparts.
margins_costs.quote: And then the warehouse sales is our highest margin product.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts expects material cost to typically range between 34% and 37% of business revenue.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing situation in West Asia has exerted pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts achieved EBITDA margins of 24% in Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management views a 20% EBITDA margin as sustainable over the cycle and expects to operate comfortably above that level as volumes build in FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability was impacted by INR 3.4 crores due to the implementation of the new wage code in November 2025.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Uniparts holds a trailing 12-month new business order book exceeding INR 225 crores across its three product platforms.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Warehouse sales accounted for roughly 56% of total revenue in Q1 FY27 compared to 50% to 52% in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q1 FY27, our warehousing sales was roughly at about 56%.

orders_capacity.claim: Uniparts India has a trailing twelve-month new business order book of over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month new business wins exceeded INR 225 crores in annualized potential, representing a 12.5% quarter-on-quarter increase.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Order books showed sequential strengthening in Q4 FY26 compared to Q3 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Order books strengthened sequentially compared to the quarter 3 FY26, although the pace of recovery varied across geographies and industry segments.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts closed Q1 FY27 with a net cash balance of approximately INR 190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Net working capital was 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of June 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net working capital stands at 139 days of trailing 12 months revenue as of 30th June, reflecting our near-shoring and warehousing-led business model while remaining broadly under control.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts is closely evaluating about half a dozen inorganic growth opportunities in hydraulics, PTOs, and fabrications.
capital_allocation.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts generated INR 44 crores of operating cash during Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts India held a net cash position of INR 190 crore at the end of Q1.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts India declared a special dividend of INR 101 crore in October 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To put this in context: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Total dividends distributed for FY26 reached INR 170 crores, including a special dividend of INR 101 crores declared in Q3 FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintained a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026 and remains net debt free.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts generated operating cash flow of INR 52 crores in Q4 FY26 and INR 174 crores for the full year FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Operating cash flow was INR52 crores in Q4 and INR174 crores in FY26.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation continues to exert pressure on input costs and supply chain logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate discretionary purchasing in the aftermarket segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher prices resulting from tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred at the Ludhiana finishing shop facility during Q3 FY26, which is fully covered under insurance.
risks_headwinds.quote: The incident is fully covered under our insurance policy and the claim was filed during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain uncertainty and input price escalation arose in March following fresh tensions in West Asia.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects first customer deliveries from its Mexico warehouse facility in Q3 of the current fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Full-year revenue growth for FY27 is projected to be a couple of percentage points higher than FY26 growth.
management_commitments.quote: our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful business vertical within 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: Mexico operations are on track to deliver first customer shipments from the warehouse in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Restoration of the Ludhiana facility finishing shop is progressing on schedule.
management_commitments.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects FY27 revenue growth to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: Rebuilding efforts for the Ludhiana facility are planned to bring operations back online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
